releaseNotesBody:
SinKey v1.0.16 — Plan Upgrade Sync Fix

🔧 CRITICAL BUG FIXES
- Fixed: When you upgrade your plan on myfonts.lk (monthly → yearly/lifetime), SinKey now picks up the new plan and expiry within 60 seconds
- Fixed: Plan upgrades and renewals now take effect almost instantly instead of waiting 30 minutes
- Fixed: Server now correctly updates device limits on plan upgrade (monthly=2 → yearly/lifetime=5)
- Fixed: Stale key metadata after upgrade no longer causes false expired status
